name: @zhenre/core
description: @zhenre core — fine-grained signals, tagged-template DOM engine, anchored keyed lists, native Web Components, cleanup contexts. Zero dependencies, ~4KB.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=dist/re.js && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --minify --outfile=dist/re.min.js && terser dist/re.min.js --compress passes=3,unsafe_arrows=true,unsafe=true,unsafe_math=true --mangle --format indent_level=0,comments=false -o dist/re.min.js && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
